volume.title: Spec book index

contents.entry: Pointers: parent (the plan step), the DAG, the schema, the check
Purpose and how to read the book
Nodes: every DAG node with its input, output and volumes
Tooling: check.sh, the XSD, the generators

pointers.sibling: The DAG volume in Markdown with its Mermaid block

purpose.s: This is the index of the spec book, the single canonical design of the rebuilt factory (owner ruling C42, D14); every build ticket is cut from an anchor in this book and from nothing else.
Read one volume at a time: start at the node's row below, follow its spec pointer, then the shared anchors the spec cites; a volume is 1000 lines or fewer and opens with its contents.
Every node has status specified once its spec volume exists under nodes/; pending means the directory is not there yet, so sibling pointers to this index always resolve.

volume.edition: A merge that changes any volume bumps this value (BOOK_VERSION in bin/make-index.py) in the same pull request; N-47 names Drive copies by it and refuses a publish of a version whose Drive manifest holds different volume hashes (drive.copy 423 version-not-bumped).

node.name: State store
node.input: Commit request over gRPC from an authenticated principal (operation key with request hash, fence, preconditions, entity writes, records, outbox effects)
node.output: commit reply (seq, epoch, hash, versions) or a refusal: 403 record.refused, 409 conflict, 412 stale token

node.name: Lease service
node.input: ticket.ready record (claimable node and attempt)
node.output: lease row (class, state, non-empty holder, integer token, generation, expiry) reserved in N-07's GrantDispatch, or lease.refused

node.name: Ticket intake and readiness
node.input: ticket record (validated, files declared, deps named; re-entry from N-18 or an owner cut) or a ticket.request admitted as a spec-phase cut request
node.output: ticket.ready record (deps done, no file claimed by another in-flight ticket) or ticket.waiting

node.name: GitHub poll
node.input: tick record (every tick from N-06, plus coq/gate statuses posted by N-25)
node.output: forge.snapshot record (open PRs, head shas, coq/gate status, mergeability, main sha)

node.name: Backups
node.input: backup.tick record (schedule from N-06) over the live store
node.output: backup record (snapshot path, checksum, class tick, daily, monthly or manual) or backup.failed

node.name: Service unit, clock and health
node.input: unit.start (systemd user unit of the Go service)
node.output: tick record (scheduler, poll, backup, stall and daily ticks) and health record (gRPC Health, counters)

node.name: Scheduler tick and dispatch
node.input: lease record plus tick record (level-triggered: compare open work with live runs before any dispatch)
node.output: dispatch record (the contracts dispatch body: ticket, phase, role, attempt, lease key and token, deadline_at, repo_sha, brief path), committed with the lease and the ticket transition in one GrantDispatch

node.name: Gate check
node.input: forge.snapshot record for a PR head sha
node.output: gate.verdict record (green, red or pending for the head sha, from the coq/gate status the agent can read but not edit)

node.name: Merge
node.input: gate.verdict green plus review.passed on the same head sha
node.output: merge record (merge sha, PR number) or merge.conflict 409

node.name: Main verdict and hold
node.input: main.gate.status record (coq/gate on the main sha after a merge)
node.output: verified 201 record, or rejected 422 plus merge.hold record (no merge until a green main)

node.name: Retry and backoff
node.input: failure record (seat.result blocked or failed, review.changes, merge.conflict, stall, validator refusal)
node.output: attempt record n+1 when the [retry owner](shared/contracts.xml#retry-owner) table charges it, or dead record with one escalation

node.name: Stall timer
node.input: lease record plus heartbeat records plus stall tick
node.output: stall record (lease revoked, kill:run_id written for the launcher, reason) when no progress within the stall bound

node.name: Seat layer render
node.input: dispatch record (role, repo, build-mode state)
node.output: seat.bundle record (settings.json from the role, deny list from declared files, brief, hash)

node.name: Workspace provision
node.input: dispatch record
node.output: workspace record (worktree path, branch from origin/main, slot, file claims checked and recorded) or workspace.refused

node.name: One-shot seat launcher
node.input: seat.bundle plus workspace record
node.output: seat.result record always (outcome, cost, turns, terminal reason, session id; a dead run yields blocked) and heartbeat records while it runs

node.name: Worker run
node.input: worker brief inside a seat run (ticket, workspace)
node.output: pr.opened record (branch pushed, PR number, head sha) or seat.result blocked

node.name: Spec-author run
node.input: spec-author brief inside a seat run (design anchor, group, verdict from a failed attempt when retried)
node.output: ticket-set.draft record (tickets as data: files, acceptance commands, input and output declared)

node.name: Validator
node.input: ticket-set.draft record
node.output: ticket records accepted (acceptance commands run on main with observed exit codes) or validator.refused with the failing command

node.name: Reviewer run
node.input: reviewer brief inside a seat run (PR, gate green, diff)
node.output: review.passed 201 or review.changes 422 record on the head sha

node.name: Jenkins as code
node.input: jenkins config record (JCasC, job by config, pinned image, resources, Longhorn home; a commit in gitops)
node.output: job.registered record (config hash, image digest, resource limits, home volume)

node.name: Factory namespace
node.input: namespace manifest record (ResourceQuota, LimitRange, PriorityClass, service account with no secret access, egress to cluster DNS, the Jenkins controller, GitHub and GHCR; a commit in gitops)
node.output: namespace.ready record (Argo synced, quota and policy present)

node.name: Image build
node.input: image config record (images.json or Containerfile change, digest pins)
node.output: image record (ghcr digest, pinned in config, checksum-verified binaries)

node.name: Suite planner
node.input: pr.opened record (head sha, diff)
node.output: suite.plan record (suites from the diff; an unmapped path plans the full set)

node.name: Pod run
node.input: suite.plan entry (one case)
node.output: pod.run record (exit code, log path, infrastructure retries by the ladder; an assertion failure never retried)

node.name: Gate status post
node.input: pod.run records for one head sha
node.output: commit status coq/gate on the head sha (success, failure, error superseded) plus the gate page link

node.name: Main verify pipeline
node.input: merge record (main push sha)
node.output: main.gate.status record (coq/gate on the main sha, full suite set)

node.name: Watcher lamp
node.input: tier unit start (the wait loop of a bearings tier as its own supervised unit)
node.output: watcher.alive record (lock with heartbeat per tier); a card cannot post without it

node.name: System lane card builder
node.input: record whose status code maps to owner-acts (dead, rejected main, exit test, unhealthy) plus watcher.alive
node.output: card record (one decision: about, decide, options with what happens, recommendation) posted to the tier

node.name: Owner answer intake
node.input: answer record (the owner's pick and words on the page, re-entry from N-32, or relayed from chat and recorded)
node.output: ruling record in the store (card id, pick, words, at) that gates and cut-over nodes read

node.name: Go inbox with acks
node.input: message record (the owner's message on the page, re-entry from N-32)
node.output: routed.message record (lane and consumer by rule) and ack record delivered back to the page

node.name: Push transport
node.input: record.committed seq from the store
node.output: pushed.frame record per client (delivered seq; full state re-read on reconnect)

node.name: Bearings page service
node.input: pushed.frame record (cards, messages, acks, panels, staleness)
node.output: page.state record (rendered page, staleness shown); the owner's answers and messages leave as new traversals at N-29 and N-30

node.name: Rail panel
node.input: plan ledger row (pushed)
node.output: rail.panel frame (plan steps, ledger, status codes) inside the page

node.name: Tailnet front door
node.input: page.up record (tier server listening on loopback)
node.output: front-door record (tailnet bind, port, pid; retried 3 times then exit 4)

node.name: Hello page deploy
node.input: map app commit (Jenkinsfile with jenkins-shared-lib, image on ghcr.io/jkkelley, app entry in homelab-gitops)
node.output: deploy record (image digest, Argo synced, HAProxy route, Lightsail name map.gatehouse.click answering 200)

node.name: Art pipeline
node.input: art inventory record (Krastor class 1 files, original art for belts, inserters, lamps and pipes)
node.output: sprite.sheet record (atlas, attribution text, license text; no Wube-derived or BiusArt file)

node.name: Panel binding registry
node.input: screen spec volume (every panel of the five screens)
node.output: binding record (panel to store record kind) and binding.check result; an unbound panel fails the build

node.name: Map screen
node.input: pushed.frame record (DAG nodes with status and heartbeat, queues with depth, seats in flight, the hold lamp)
node.output: map.frame (machines, belts, inserters, lamps at the frame budget) and selection record

node.name: Machine screen
node.input: selection record plus the node's state frame
node.output: machine.panel frame (one node: input, output, attempt, lease, last records)

node.name: Stats screen
node.input: counters frame (records, jobs, wakes, seats, pods, cost)
node.output: stats.frame (production statistics panel)

node.name: Alerts screen
node.input: alert records (stall, dead, rejected main, unhealthy)
node.output: alerts.frame and alert.ack record

node.name: Controls screen
node.input: controls frame (hold flag, build-mode state, watcher lamp, health)
node.output: control.action record (owner-initiated: hold, resume, build-mode, one-time break glass) as a new traversal at N-29

node.name: Status code map loader
node.input: shared/status-codes.xml commit
node.output: code.table record (version hash loaded by Reload; every code names who acts)

node.name: Build-mode flag
node.input: ruling record that sets the flag (with expiry)
node.output: build-mode.state record (on or off, expiry; cleared by the system at expiry)

node.name: Cleanup registry and runs
node.input: trigger record (merge record for branch and worktree release, backup record for retention, timer for state paths named in runbook volumes)
node.output: cleanup.run record (dry-run listing, then deletions, 3 attempts then reported)

node.name: Spec book check
node.input: spec volume commit in a suite plan (rebuild/design paths)
node.output: check.verdict record (XSD, every pointer resolves, 1000-line cap, contents element, parent pointer, many agents section)

node.name: Drive publish
node.input: merge record touching rebuild/design
node.output: drive.copy record (version-named file ids, immutable)

node.name: Tier promotion with screenshot
node.input: pr.opened or merge record touching tools/bearings or the map app
node.output: promotion record (dev then uat then stable swapped in place without stopping the waits) with the screenshot record attached

node.name: Unlanded cleanup
node.input: GOFACTORY ruling record
node.output: disposition records, one per 04-UNLANDED entry (land, supersede, close), dry-run listing first

node.name: Cut-over records
node.input: GOFACTORY ruling plus the D09 and D14 rulings
node.output: cancel records for the fourteen SPEC-16 tickets, PR 35 close record, design branch delete record

node.name: Exit test
node.input: daily tick plus the day's verified records, line-ops audit and git status
node.output: exit.verdict record (zero agent line operations and a clean checkout, or not); product freeze lifts only on pass

node.name: Phone push bridge
node.input: card record
node.output: push.receipt record (the provider accepted it) and push.observed (the phone fetched it); ships dark until the Go inbox is live

groups.s: One author seat per group; a node belongs to exactly one group; groups never overlap in files (dag.md section 5).

tooling.s: check.sh runs bin/check-book.py: checks C01 to C32 and C16-edges as listed in nodes/N-46/spec.xml#checks (well-formed, XSD, the 1000-line cap, contents, parent, pointers, many agents, no dashes, unique ids, JSON schemas, index completeness and line counts, envelope, waits, cleanup registry, record kinds, the DAG, index freshness, codes, input and output, panel bindings, examples against their schemas, edge fixtures, ticket transitions, operation keys, CI capacity, retry composition, deadline nesting, review dispositions, no personal data, owner words); one line per failure; exit 0, 1 or 2.

Generators, each with --check: bin/make-index.py (this file, with a line count per volume), bin/make-kinds.py (shared/record-kinds.xml), bin/registry.py (shared/cleanup-registry.json); bin/dag-check.py checks dag.md; bin/test-checks.py proves every check fails on a mutated copy of the book. N-37 reads the nodes element to generate machines.json.
schema/volume.xsd descends from rebuild/schema/factory-rebuild-plan.xsd: the same envelope (contents, ids, UTC), extended with the volume kinds and the shared vocabulary.

many-agents.readers: Every seat starts here; fifty can read it at once because it is generated, stateless and anchored by node id.
many-agents.writers: Nobody edits it by hand: a node directory appearing or a dag.md row changing regenerates it in the same pull request (the generator runs in the pre-commit of a design ticket and N-46 runs --check); two tickets adding two nodes regenerate the same file, and the second to merge re-runs the generator on rebase, so the file never carries a merge conflict a human resolves.
many-agents.collision: Two tickets claiming one node directory are refused at readiness (one file, one in-flight ticket); the index has no state of its own to collide on.
